name: markdown-frontend-open-points
body:
Design points for the markdown frontend, reconciled against the rules now pinned. Every previously-deferred markdown design point is DECIDED; markdown links (link references becoming graph edges) are DEFERRED out of this change-set (requirements.note.markdown-links-deferred).

DECIDED (pinned):
- FQN scheme (feedback-12; requirements.requirement.markdown-sections-as-symbols, requirements.requirement.markdown-accept-extensions, domain.value.module-fqn-prefix): a markdown Module's FQN is `md.` + its directory's absolute path (language-rooted); a markdown File's FQN is the file's absolute path with the extension retained (`docs/README.md` and `docs/README.markdown` stay distinct); a heading section's FQN extends its parent section's FQN (`<parent-section-fqn>.<section>`), a top-level heading hanging directly off the File. Absolute paths are unique per file and per directory and begin with `/`, and each slug is a single delimiter-free segment, so path-derived markdown identities are disjoint and no two files or directories alias; dot-joined directory prefixes are rejected as lossy.
- Section shape: there is NO synthesized document-root Struct — links were the only reason it existed and links are deferred. A heading is a Struct section nested by heading level; a heading-less document yields only its File node, no sections.
- Slug rule — DECIDED (requirements.constraint.markdown-slug-rule), GitHub-style: trim, Unicode-normalize (NFC), lowercase, whitespace runs -> `-`, drop punctuation other than `-`/`_` (non-ASCII letters/digits preserved), collapse/trim `-`; duplicates in one file get `-1`, `-2`, … (first occurrence bare). One segment, never embeds `.`.
- Frontend implementation — DECIDED: a new Rust standalone binary under src/mdlib, built by build.rs and staged as `mdfrontend` (bare-binary convention like pyfrontend/csharpfrontend/rustfrontend). Planned code, no implemented-by.
- Accept set — DECIDED: `.md` and `.markdown` only; `.mdx` is OUT (JSX-embedded; not the markdown frontend's concern).

No open markdown design points remain. Link path-resolution (file-relative vs repo-root-relative) and the link anchoring/target rules are deferred with the whole link feature (requirements.note.markdown-links-deferred).
